Heraclius questioned Abu Sufyan about the Prophet, read his letter inviting him to Islam, and urged the Byzantines to pledge allegiance to him, then drew back when they recoiled.
The Prophet's letter invites Caesar to Islam; Heraclius questions Abu Sufyan, finds in his answers the qualities of a prophet, and his court breaks into uproar.
Heraclius of Byzantium questioned Abu Sufyan about the Prophet, said the answers marked a true prophet, and read the letter calling him to Islam and to a common word.
The Prophet swore that once Caesar and Khosrau are ruined no Caesar or Khosrau will follow them, and that their treasures will be spent in Allah's Cause.
